extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors seeking to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural checks for creating, locating, or troubleshooting a missing Wikipedia article title (e.g., whether the page exists, account requirements, title issues, and deletion checks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit prerequisite for creating articles; if you cannot create the page, ensure you are logged in and meet autoconfirmed status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions or prefer guided creation, submit a draft via the article wizard or ask experienced editors to create the article through a request process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Universal humor' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia for synonyms, alternate spellings, or existing coverage to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' or similar tools to find incoming links which can reveal existing coverage or suggest appropriate article placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation propagation delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you just created the page and cannot see it, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh cached views.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and, if appropriate, create a redirect from alternative capitalizations or spellings to the canonical page title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log / deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page disappears, consult the deletion log and related help pages to understand deletion reasons and learn how to address issues (notability, sourcing, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects for related content
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Universal humor on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary (dictionary), Wikibooks (textbooks), Wikiquote (quotations), Wikisource (library), Wikiversity (learning resources), Commons (media), Wikivoyage (travel guide), Wikinews (news source), Wikidata (linked database), Wikispecies (species directory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If encyclopedic coverage is lacking on Wikipedia, related material may exist on sister projects; consult them for definitions, quotes, media, or structured data.
